A:

Asset type: 2D arcade videogame dancing character sprite atlas.
Create an exactly 3-column by 4-row sprite atlas: 12 separate full-body isolated sprites. Prefer 1536x2048 portrait canvas. Flat perfectly solid chroma green #00ff00 background. Each equal cell holds one complete sprite centered inside generous clear green margins, no overlaps. No grid, text, numbers, captions, watermark, floor or ground shadow.
Style: friendly detailed shaded 2D pixel arcade sprites with crisp dark black outlines and bright colors. Kuwaiti atmosphere, expressive friendly faces, original characters. Faithful consistent clothing, faces, proportions, accessories and size across each character's three poses.
The three columns show ACTUALLY DIFFERENT standing DANCE poses, front / mild three-quarter view, not running or walking: column 1 elbows down/out with left knee bent and toe tapped outward; column 2 arms overhead with right foot lifted sideways; column 3 arms spread sideways and left knee raised. Arm and leg silhouettes must be visibly different across all three columns. Each character stays upright dancing joyfully in place. Full body, hands, feet and accessories visible and separated from other sprites.
Rows top to bottom: 1) adult Kuwaiti man with black moustache, white dishdasha, white ghutra and black agal, brown sandals; 2) cheerful adult woman in modest long teal dress and matching teal hijab; 3) cheerful boy in a white thobe, small embroidered cap and shoes; 4) cheerful young girl in purple modest long dress, purple head covering and white sneakers.
